launch: Show me {a} times {b} with your hands.
hesitation_1: Take your time. I'm watching your hands.
hesitation_2: Start by finding {a} on your left hand.
visibility_none: Bring both hands into the camera.
visibility_one: I can see one hand. Show me both.
visibility_keep: Keep your hands where I can see them.
wrong_right: Your left hand is right. Find {b} on your right hand.
wrong_left: Your right hand is right. Find {a} on your left hand.
wrong_both: Check both fingers. Find {a} on the left and {b} on the right.
not_touching: You found the fingers. Touch them together.
pose_ready: You have the pose. Now count the tens.
count_tens: Count the touching fingers and the ones below.
wrong_answer_1: Keep the pose. Count the tens again.
rescue: {tens} tens make {tens_value}. {u1} times {u2} makes {units}. That gives {total}.
autonomous: You solved that without a hint. I'll give you more space on the next one.
